title: Design System: B1G Sportship — Player Inventory

metric.purpose: Stat card values only — the one number-forward size in the system.

headline.purpose: Page-level titles, one per step (Upload / Possible duplicate / Batch resolved).

title.purpose: Card-level primary content — submission and candidate names share this size deliberately, so neither is visually biased in the comparison.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, button labels, form input text.

label.purpose: Section labels, form field labels, and secondary meta lines — one size for every 'supporting text' tier, sentence case, no eyebrow treatment.

kbd.purpose: Keyboard-shortcut hint chips only — the floor of the scale.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The system's only shadow — ambient lift for every card, no hierarchy meaning.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Shared entrance for arriving at a new step (select, summary).

motion.name: advance-in
motion.purpose: Signature transition reserved for advancing through the triage queue — reads as moving forward, distinct from a generic entrance.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action per step (Process roster, etc). Ember fill with Graphite text — never white text, see the Ember Contrast Rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; background-color: #FF6F2F; color: #1D1D1F; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #F2621F; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background-color: #E0551A; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #FF6F2F; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action that still needs presence — e.g. a triage candidate's 'Same person' action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; background-color: #ffffff; color: #1D1D1F; border: 1px solid #D2D2D7; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #F5F5F7; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Lowest-emphasis action on a screen, e.g. 'Skip' in the triage queue.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; background-color: transparent; color: #6E6E73; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: #F5F5F7; color: #1D1D1F; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The system's only container. Always the single ambient shadow plus a hairline border, never a background shift off canvas.
components.html:
This week's submission
Miguel Santos
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #E5E5E7; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-card-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #6E6E73; } .ds-card-title { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: #1D1D1F; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Card variant for the batch-summary and dashboard KPI grids — a label, a large proportional-figure number (never tabular-nums at this size), and an optional accent treatment on the value.
components.html:
New players
4
components.css: .ds-stat-card { padding: 20px; } .ds-stat-value { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-stat-value--accent { color: #C2450F; }

components.name: Accent Badge
components.description: Pill badge tied to the accent's meaning — e.g. the triage queue's position counter. Reserved for genuinely accent-meaningful state, not decorative repetition (a list of tied tags uses Neutral instead).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-badge--accent { background: #FFF1E8; color: #C2450F; } .ds-badge--neutral { background: #F5F5F7; color: #6E6E73; } .ds-badge--success { background: #EAF7F0; color: #1A7F4B; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Date and text fields on the select step. Solid border, Ember focus ring — never a border-color-only focus change.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #D2D2D7; background: #ffffff; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 15px; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A1A1A6; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FF6F2F; }

components.name: Keyboard Hint Chip
components.description: Signature component — a single-character keycap attached inline to the triage action it triggers (1 / N / S).
components.css: .ds-kbd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: 8px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid #D2D2D7; background: #F5F5F7; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #A1A1A6; }

components.name: Line Chart
components.description: Trend chart (e.g. Returnees vs. First-timers per game night). 2px lines round-capped, hairline solid gridlines, always-on legend for 2+ series, direct end-labels only, hover crosshair + tooltip, table-view twin. Colors from Colors → Chart Series, never eyeballed.
components.css: .ds-chart-grid { stroke: #E5E5E7; stroke-width: 1; } .ds-chart-line { fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-chart-line--returnee { stroke: #2A78D6; } .ds-chart-line--firsttimer { stroke: #FF6F2F; } .ds-chart-dot { stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-chart-dot--returnee { fill: #2A78D6; }

components.name: Bar Chart
components.description: Ranked comparison chart (e.g. first-timers by sport). Bars rounded on top corners only (4px), square at the baseline — never rounded on all four. Single accent hue for a single-series comparison; hover tooltip per bar; table-view twin.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: The one sanctioned exception to the system's no-chrome discipline — a 56px top bar, added once a 4-page product had no way to move between pages. Shows the same three links (Upload, Players, Dashboard) on every page — access control is deferred, so a role-split nav would hide links without gating anything. Active link is weight+ink only, never a pill or underline.
components.html: UploadPlayersDashboard
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E5E7; } .ds-nav-inner { max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 24px; } .ds-nav-logo img { height: 24px; width: auto; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #6E6E73; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-nav-link--active { font-weight: 600; color: #1D1D1F; }

narrative.overview:
This is an operator's panel, not a showcase — a single admin, alone, weekly, dropping a file and trusting the system to place the obvious cases silently while surfacing only what genuinely needs a human call. Every device in the system serves that: a white canvas with almost no chrome, one accent color spent only where a decision or a status actually lives, generous whitespace that reads as calm rather than empty, and a triage step built to be operated — keyboard shortcuts, a forward-advancing transition, a queue that shrinks as you work it.

The system fuses three references named directly in the brief: Apple Health's native chrome, generous whitespace, and card-based data presentation; Linear's snappy, deliberate, keyboard-fast interaction texture; and Notion/Things 3's calm, content-first, single-item focus. Nothing here is warm or ministry-themed by design — this tool serves a church sports program, but its register is neutral efficient utility, deliberately separated from the program's own identity. It explicitly rejects the generic SaaS admin dashboard: no sidebar, no data-table-plus-chart-widgets scaffold, no navigation chrome standing between the admin and the task.
keyCharacteristics: White/clean ground as the overwhelming majority of every screen; color is earned, never ambient.
One accent (Ember, #FF6F2F) spent only on primary actions and states that need attention — never decorative, never small standalone text.
Cards are the only container, always soft-shadowed, never bordered-and-shadowed at once.
Motion is signature, not scattered: a shared entrance fade for arriving at a step, a distinct forward-slide reserved for advancing through the triage queue.
No kickers, no eyebrows, no uppercase tracked labels anywhere in the system.
Chart series are a separate, validated extension (blue + Ember) — CVD-checked, never eyeballed, never expanded past the documented palette order.

rules.name: The Ember Contrast Rule
rules.body: Ember (#FF6F2F) has a measured WCAG contrast of ~2.8:1 against both white and black at small sizes — it fails body-text contrast either way. Ember therefore only ever appears as a fill (paired with Graphite text on top, never white) or as Ember Ink (#C2450F) when the accent needs to be small text or an icon directly on canvas. Never render raw Ember as text.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Ember is the only saturated color with a decorative role in the system. Success and Danger are status signals, not palette options — do not reach for them to add visual variety.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No label in the system is uppercase, letter-spaced, or set above a heading as a kicker. Section labels sit at Label size, sentence case, directly adjacent to the content they describe.

rules.name: The One-Shadow Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one shadow value. If a new component seems to need a different depth, that is a signal to reconsider the component, not to add a shadow tier.

dos: Do spend Ember only on fills paired with Graphite text, or as Ember Ink for small text/icons directly on canvas — never raw Ember as text.
Do keep every card at the single Card shadow value and 16px radius, no exceptions.
Do set section/field labels in sentence case at Label size, adjacent to their content — never as an uppercase kicker above it.
Do use tabular figures only for aligned columns and compact inline counters — never on a large standalone stat value.
Do reserve Success/Danger strictly for status, never as palette variety.
Do validate any new chart series color with validate_palette.js before shipping it — never eyeball CVD-safety.
donts: Don't introduce a sidebar, or any chrome beyond the one documented top bar — no secondary toolbars, breadcrumbs, or decorative header content.
Don't add a second accent color. One accent, spent deliberately, is the system's discipline.
Don't use white text on Ember; it fails contrast at this hue (~2.8:1) regardless of weight or size.
Don't reach for progress bars, completion badges, or celebratory motion — this is a chore tool, not a gamified habit app.
Don't stack a border, a shadow, and a background-color shift on the same card edge.
Don't invent a new chart series hue past the documented palette order — the next slot is aqua, not a generated color.
